integrity: The formulas are proved from the coordinate-support description of annihilators; finite computations are replay checks only and are not used as a proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite direct products of fields.
A later finite-reduced-ring support paper was available only at abstract level during comparison.
An equivalent formula could exist under different terminology or in an unindexed source.
title: Exact distance enumerator for annihilator graphs of finite semisimple rings
